about_the_game:
Shrouded Siege is a tactical tower defense game where you build labyrinths to defend sacred shrines to Irish gods from evil forces. Each maze is a tactical puzzle, with terrain features like leylines that will enhance your towers, bogs you can mire your enemies in, and heavy fog that will make the battle map a mystery. Fortunately, the ancient gods of Ireland will help aid you in your quest, and mixing and matching their boons on the right towers will allow you to create devastating combos. 

Shrouded siege has been designed to be enjoyed with friends. Campaigns are fully playable in groups of up to 4.

Our assets are being hand-made every day, so we haven't put nice GIFs up yet since they will be out of date tomorrow. For now, your imagination will have to help you to imagine these features. We also probably didn't expect you to find our page yet. 

CONTROL THE BATTLEFIELD!

Send enemies into bogs, chop down trees, and create new paths to create the most diabolical maze!

CREATE SYNERGISTIC DEFENSIVE BUILDS!

Combine 50+ different abilities on up to 30+ different towers using 30+ different artifacts to build an unstoppable defense. Discover unique synergies with critical strikes, attack speed, high damage, special statuses, and more!

PLAY WITH YOUR FRIENDS!

Shrouded siege supports up to 4 players, and provides collaborative tools so that you can plan out your mazes with your friends. You can also buff each other's towers to make synergistic combo-builds.

MASTER THE TERRAIN!

Shrouded siege has 30+ hand made maps, but they are randomized slightly to make them familiar but different every time. Bogs, grass, stone, sand, forests, lava, rocks, and cliffs can all affect your towers and even sometimes the enemies. There is also a plethora of special tiles that can mix things up even further.

short_description: A maze-building, roguelike, tower defense designed from the ground up to be a great solo or co-op experience. Each Irish mythology-inspired campaign is unique, with unending combinations of upgrades to combine, and each battle is filled with unique and randomized tactical challenges to overcome.
